assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: responsive background texture for a web proof center about the I Ching as a finite mathematical system
Primary request: a restrained, low-contrast field of pale handmade Chinese paper with extremely subtle dry-brush ink traces and fine paper fibers, suitable behind dense user interface content
Scene/backdrop: flat archival paper surface, softly lit, no horizon and no objects
Subject: abstract paper grain and sparse nonrepresentational ink wash only
Style/medium: refined contemporary ink-on-paper texture, quiet scholarly atmosphere, realistic paper fibers
Composition/framing: seamless-feeling wide field, even visual weight, generous calm negative space, no focal symbol
Lighting/mood: diffuse neutral daylight, contemplative and precise
Color palette: warm off-white paper, charcoal gray, a very restrained muted mineral green accent
Materials/textures: xuan paper fibers, dry brush granulation, faint deckle variation
Constraints: decorative non-informational background only; no readable text; no Chinese characters; no Latin letters; no numbers; no hexagrams; no trigrams; no yin-yang symbol; no mathematical diagrams; no graph nodes or edges; no seals; no watermark; no people; no objects; no fake manuscript; low contrast enough for dark UI text
negativeConstraints: no hexagrams, trigrams, or yin-yang symbols
no mathematical diagrams, graph nodes, or semantic edges
no seals, watermark, people, objects, or fake manuscript
assets.fallback: 淡色纸纹装饰层不可用时，保留纯色纸面背景。
assets.usageBoundary: 仅作装饰气氛，不承载证明、数学真值、卦象关系或古代原文。
manualEdits: WebP quality 72 编码；未进行语义性图像修改
